description: Writes each variant's filter values into its syncs again, as the app's Reapply does: after syncs were added to the template, or a filter changed on its dashboard. It reads the dashboards with your access to their connections, and runs nothing: run the variants afterwards with startBurstRun. Members who only contribute reapply their own variants. A Rollstack report's burst returns 400.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

variantIds.description: The variants to act on, by their `id` in `listBurstVariants`, instead of every variant. Each must be a variant of this burst. 1 to 500 ids.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: reapplyBurstFilters
title: Reapply burst filters
